product_one_liner.value: SiteVue AI uses fixed and wearable cameras with custom-trained video analytics to give manufacturing and other industrial operations leaders real-time visibility into productivity, quality, and safety.
product_one_liner.notes: The company description says its proprietary fixed-mounted and wearable cameras pair with AI video analytics to make production operations actionable and give operations leaders visibility. The exhibitor profile identifies manufacturers, processors, and builders as the target users and lists analysis of bottlenecks, defects, cycle times, and safety.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage footer lists Press, Careers, and Contact under Company, with no pricing link. Although product pages describe subscription charging, the cited homepage navigation/footer does not expose a public pricing page.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The company homepage customer testimonials name Marksbury Farms, Foster Farms, and XOS Trucks as customers. | named_customers.0: The homepage testimonial names Marksbury Farms. | named_customers.1: The homepage testimonial names Foster Farms. | named_customers.2: The homepage testimonial names XOS Trucks.

employee_band.notes: The company LinkedIn profile reports 40 employees, which falls in the 21-50 band.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company LinkedIn profile identifies its headquarters as Franklin, Tennessee; the city component is Franklin. | hq_country: The headquarters listing identifies Franklin, Tennessee, United States, establishing the country as the United States.

founded_year.notes: The company description states that SiteVue AI was founded in August 2025, supporting 2025 as its founding year.

eng_blog.notes: The company blog index describes deployment stories, operational insights, and practical advice for manufacturing leaders. It does not identify engineering or technical posts about how the product is built, so it does not meet the engineering-blog criterion. The index was not fully accessible, which leaves some uncertainty.

public_docs.notes: The homepage footer links to press, careers, and contact but no documentation, help center, or developer portal, supporting that public product documentation is not offered through the site.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The company careers page is a coming-soon page being put together and lists no openings or job titles, so no open AI/ML/data-science role is shown.

model_provider.notes: The investor’s company profile says SiteVue designs its own cameras and trains its own AI models, supporting the answer that it uses in-house, custom-trained models rather than a publicly named third-party model provider.
